{{Quote|I’m a duly elected government official.|Bok Yost|<ref name="COO" />}}
'''Bok Yost''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] who rigged an election on [[Elegasso]] to earn his post. He suspected that the rogue [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] group [[Hand of Judgment]] would seek to stop him and laid a trap for them. While he successfully captured them and planned to turn them in as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] deserters, they were rescued by the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who slew his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and compelled his resignation in favor of holding new, fair elections.
